name: Drink & Draw at Allmo
description: Unleash your creativity at a casual 'Drink & Draw' session with guest artist Karolina Borowska. A fun, social way to make art.
longDescription:
This 'Drink & Draw' event at Allmo offers an opportunity for individuals to engage in artistic expression in a relaxed setting. The session is guided by guest artist Karolina Borowska, providing a structured yet informal environment for participants to explore drawing techniques and creative ideas. The initiative aims to foster a community around art-making, making it accessible to those with varying levels of experience.

Attendees can expect a convivial atmosphere, conducive to both artistic exploration and social interaction. The duration of the event is designed to allow ample time for drawing and conversation. The session is open to a general adult audience, encouraging a diverse mix of participants. Allmo provides an intimate setting for this creative gathering.

The price for participation varies, and further details regarding ticketing are available closer to the event date. Allmo is located within walking distance of the Bolhão metro station, approximately a 7-minute walk.
